description: Get a web page's main content as Markdown, with boilerplate stripped and structure (headings, lists, tables, links) kept. Best for reading a page or passing it to an LLM. API docs: https://webscraping.ai/docs#text

country.description: Country of the proxy to use (US by default).

custom_proxy.description: Your own proxy URL in "http://user:password@host:port" format.

error_on_404.description: Return error on 404 HTTP status on the target page (false by default).

error_on_redirect.description: Return error on redirect on the target page (false by default).

js.description: Execute on-page JavaScript using a headless browser (true by default).

js_script.description: Custom JavaScript code to execute on the target page.

js_timeout.description: Maximum JavaScript rendering time in ms (2000 by default).

proxy.description: Type of proxy: datacenter, residential, or stealth (residential by default). Use residential if the site restricts datacenter traffic, or stealth for the most heavily protected sites with advanced anti-bot detection. Residential and stealth requests cost more than datacenter — see the pricing page.

return_links.description: Return links from the page body text.

timeout.description: Maximum web page retrieval time in ms (15000 by default, maximum is 30000).

wait_for.description: CSS selector to wait for before returning the page content.

name: webscraping_ai_text
title: Get Page Text
